sc_blog.title: Blog
sc_blog.subtitle: Write and publish articles on your website. What you publish shows up right away.
sc_blog.load_error: We couldn't load this section. Reload the page.
sc_blog.forbidden: Only organization admins can see this section.

list.ai_disabled: AI is not configured on the server (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is missing).
list.ai_mock: Test mode: the AI returns a sample article.
list.empty: You don't have any articles yet. Write the first one or create it with AI.
list.job_running: Generating an article with AI… It can take 1 to 3 minutes. You can keep working.

ai.generate_intro: Describe the topic and the AI (Claude, by Anthropic) will write a draft. You can always review and edit it before publishing.
ai.prompt_placeholder: For example: how to handle a 3-year-old's tantrums without yelling
ai.keyword_hint: The phrase you would like people to find you with on Google.
ai.facts_placeholder: Date and time, place or format, price, sign-up link…
ai.facts_hint: For news and workshops the AI will only use these facts: it never makes up dates, prices, places or links. If you leave it empty, the article won't include them.
ai.privacy_warning: Don't include patient names or details: the text is sent to Anthropic to generate the article.
ai.hourly_limit: You can use the AI up to {{limit}} times per hour.
ai.working_text: This usually takes 1 to 3 minutes. You can close this window: the draft will be saved in the list.
ai.timeout: This is taking longer than usual. Come back to the list in a few minutes.
ai.error_title: The task could not be completed
ai.request_error: We couldn't start the task. Try again.
ai.status_error: We couldn't check how the task is going. Check your connection.
ai.revise_intro: Tell the AI what you want to change. It will review the whole article.
ai.revise_placeholder: For example: make it shorter and add an example of a bedtime routine
ai.revise_privacy_warning: Don't include patient names or details: the article and your instruction are sent to Anthropic to improve it.
ai.revise_dirty: Save your changes before improving with AI.
ai.revise_save_first: Save the draft to be able to improve it with AI.
ai.revise_working: Improving the article… it can take 1 to 3 minutes.
ai.revise_locked: While the AI works, the article is read-only.
ai.revise_error_title: The article could not be improved
ai.revise_applied: Done: the draft was updated with the improvement.
ai.revise_loaded: The improvement is loaded in the editor. Review the changes and press “Save changes” to publish them.
ai.revise_loaded_draft: The draft was saved while the AI was working, so the improvement was not applied on its own: it is loaded in the editor. Review the changes and press “Save draft”.

editor.title_placeholder: A clear title with the article's main idea
editor.slug_auto: If you leave it empty, it is built from the title when you save (with a number at the end if it already exists).
editor.slug_locked: The address can't be changed because the article was already published.
editor.excerpt_hint: Shown in the blog list. Required to publish.
editor.summary_hint: A direct answer of 40 to 70 words. Highlighted at the top.
editor.content_hint: Use Markdown. Don't put the main title or the FAQ here: they have their own fields.
editor.content_placeholder: Start with one or two paragraphs that connect with the reader. Use “Section title” to organize the text.
editor.preview_empty: Write something to see the preview.
editor.preview_error: We couldn't build the preview. Try again.
editor.preview_hint: This is how the content will look on the site. The title, summary and FAQ are shown separately.
editor.faq_hint: 3 to 5 questions someone would search on Google, with answers of 40 to 80 words.
editor.meta_title_hint: If you leave it empty, the title is used.
editor.meta_description_hint: If you leave it empty, the excerpt is used. Ideal: 140 to 155 characters.
editor.keywords_hint: 4 to 8, lowercase; the main one first.
editor.cover_hint: JPG, PNG or WebP up to 5 MB. It is optimized automatically.
editor.cover_too_big: The image is larger than 5 MB.
editor.cover_save_first: Save the draft to be able to upload a cover.
editor.cover_error: We couldn't upload the image. Try again.
editor.cover_remove_error: We couldn't remove the cover. Try again.
editor.cover_alt_hint: Describe the image for people who can't see it.
editor.draft_hint: Only you can see it. Publish it when it's ready.
editor.published: Article published. It's live on the site.
editor.unpublished: The article is no longer shown on the site.
editor.save_error: We couldn't save the changes. Try again.
editor.fix_errors: Check the fields marked in red.
editor.leave_confirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving them?
editor.published_live_hint: This article is published: when you save, the changes show up on the site right away.
editor.delete_confirm_text: “{{title}}” and its cover will be deleted. This action can't be undone.
editor.unpublish_confirm_text: The article will no longer be shown on the site. You can publish it again whenever you want.
editor.not_found: This article doesn't exist or was deleted.

errors.too_long: It is over the limit of {{max}} characters.
errors.slug_invalid: Use at least 3 characters: letters without accents, numbers and hyphens.
errors.publish_content: The content is too short to publish (at least {{min}} characters).

list.title: Blog
list.description: Write, create with AI and publish articles on the website
list.keywords: blog, articles, publish, ai, artificial intelligence, posts
